verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs say it offers external status pages, including FireHydrant-hosted ones. Incident updates posted via Slack or Command Center feed the per-incident internal status page, but the evidence never shows how the hosted public page is configured or how it is driven by incident state. missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notifications, documented incident-state-driven updates to the external page, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: as well as external status pages (Atlassian and FireHydrant-hosted)
All incident notes/updates posted via Slack (`/fh update`) or via Command Center are posted to the Internal Status Page
